fieldGuide.mine: made by the brand team in a chat
fieldGuide.body: the skill's SKILL.md, frontmatter included: in skill-bodies.json by skill name, loaded when a skill's page opens
fieldGuide.routines: names of the routines that use it

skills.d: Reads every tool at 6:00 AM and ranks what needs you.
skills.example: Check everything now and tell me what changed since yesterday.

versions.note: Late means 2 days for wholesale orders.

skills.d: Answers in plain English and cites the tool behind each number.
skills.example: How many Ridge 30L Packs did we sell last week, and where?

versions.note: Answers now lead with the number.

skills.d: Compares Amazon payouts with what Xero expected.
skills.example: Check this week's Amazon payouts against Xero.

skills.d: Works out how much to reorder and flags what runs out before a delivery lands.
skills.example: Do we need to reorder the Summit Fleece?

versions.note: Reorder below 21 days of stock, not 14.

skills.d: Finds purchase orders that are late and suggests asking the supplier for a new date.
skills.example: Is PO-1187 from Kestrel late, and what should I do?

versions.note: Counts the days of stock left on the order.

skills.d: Flags orders not picked after 3 days and asks the team to chase ShipBob.
skills.example: Which orders haven't been picked in 3 days?

skills.d: Reads new tickets and says who needs to hear from you first, and what to tell them.
skills.example: What should I tell the customer on the newest ticket about a late order?

versions.note: Offer a refund before a discount.

skills.d: Puts sellable returns back on sale on Shopify.
skills.example: Which returns came back this week, and which can go back on sale?

skills.d: Flags a variant when orders pass the stock on hand.

versions.note: Pauses one variant, never a whole product.

suggested.d: Finds products that will run out during the sale and suggests reorders.
Finds new product reviews that need an answer, and says why.
Checks Faire and wholesale orders against stock.
Flags ads that spend on products that are nearly out.
